extDesc.message: Grab courses, grades, and assignment due dates from Canvas and export them for Daycore's autonomous planner.

statusIdle.message: Open a logged-in Canvas page, then click Fetch.

statusNotCanvas.message: This tab is not Canvas. Open your school's Canvas and log in first; custom domains can be added in Options.

pushNoToken.message: No import token yet — open Options and paste the Import Token from Daycore's settings page.

pushNoPerm.message: Access to $ORIGIN$ has not been granted — open Options, hit Save, and allow it in the prompt.

pushBadURL.message: Invalid Daycore URL — open Options and enter a full URL, e.g. https://day.example.com.

optDaycoreURLHint.message: Use http://localhost:8080 for a local server, or your domain once deployed, e.g. https://day.example.com. Saving requests access to that origin — without it, direct sending will not work.

optToken.message: Import token (generate it in Daycore settings)

optDomains.message: Custom Canvas domains (one per line, e.g. canvas.umn.edu)

optTestBadURL.message: Invalid URL — enter a full URL, e.g. https://day.example.com.

optPermDenied.message: Saved, but access was not granted for: $MSG$
